meta.name: marketing-analytics
meta.description: Sets up, audits, and reports on marketing measurement — tracking plans, event schemas, attribution models, and the dashboards built on them. Use this to instrument a site or product, audit tracking nobody trusts, choose or interpret an attribution model, build reporting that answers a specific question, or reconcile numbers that disagree between tools.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建营销追踪并产出可信归因报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果营销数据分散在各工具,难判断哪个渠道真正带来转化
copy.tagline_en: Turn scattered marketing data into trustworthy measurement and reports.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if marketing data is scattered across tools and you can't tell which channel really drives conversions.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会先明确事件跟踪计划（事件、触发时机、属性），再审计或建立跟踪，解释归因模型偏差，最后产出回答特定问题的报告。
howto.when: 当你要埋点采集事件、审计现有跟踪数据、选择归因模型，以及处理构建报告、跨工具对账等其他测量问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我制定跟踪计划，定义“注册完成”事件何时触发、带哪些属性。
审计我们网站的跟踪，怀疑“加入购物车”事件重复触发。
say.note: 它会让你自己操作并查看事件是否按预期到达。

say.text: 比较首次点击和末次点击归因模型，哪个更利于评估内容广告？
say.note: 它会解释各模型的已知偏差并给出选择建议。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude handle marketing measurement: it defines event tracking plans, audits existing tracking reliability, explains attribution models, and produces reports that answer a specific question.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to instrument a site or product, audit existing tracking, choose or interpret an attribution model, or handle related tasks like building reports or reconciling numbers.

say_en.text: Define the 'signup_complete' event: when it fires and its properties.
say_en.note: Outputs event spec with object_action naming convention.

say_en.text: Audit our tracking; I suspect the 'add_to_cart' event fires twice.
say_en.note: Guides you to verify events by doing the action yourself.

say_en.text: Compare first-touch vs last-touch attribution for our display ads.
say_en.note: Explains each model's known bias and how to choose.
